<!-- All news items below this line -->

;Attacks and conflicts
*Gunmen ambush a bus killing nine people and wounding six others in western [[Ethiopia]] near the [[Sudan|Sudanese]] border. [https://www.reuters.com/article/2014/04/16/us-ethiopia-attacks-idUSBREA3F0FX20140416 (Reuters)]
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**More [[chemical attack]]s are reported, this time in the Damascus suburbs. [https://www.reuters.com/article/2014/04/16/us-syria-crisis-chemical-idUSBREA3F1MW20140416?feedType=RSS&feedName=topNews&dlvrit=992637 (Reuters)]
**[[Jordan|Jordanian]] warplanes strike a convoy of vehicles as they were trying to enter Jordan from Syria. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-27047864 (BBC News)]
*[[2014 pro-Russian unrest in Ukraine]]:
**Six [[Armoured personnel carrier|armored personnel carriers]] belonging to the [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian military]] are captured by pro-Russian protesters amid rising tensions between the protestors and the military.  [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-27045534 (BBC News)]
;Disasters and accidents
*[[2014 South Korean ferry capsizing]]:
**[[Yonhap]] news agency reports that the [[Republic of Korea Coast Guard]] has been dispatched to rescue a ferry with 476 passengers sinking off the southeastern coast of [[South Korea]] with claims that at least four passengers have died and scores are injured.  Approximately 280 people remain unaccounted for.  [http://bigstory.ap.org/article/reports-ferry-471-people-sinking-skorea (AP)] [https://web.archive.org/web/20140417174737/http://news.ninemsn.com.au/world/2014/04/16/12/48/rescue-for-450-on-sinking-s-korea-ferry (AFP via Nine MSN)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-27045512# (BBC News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Barry O'Farrell]] resigns as [[Premier of New South Wales|Premier]] of the [[Australia]]n state of [[New South Wales]] after giving misleading evidence to the [[Independent Commission Against Corruption (New South Wales)|Independent Commission against Corruption]]. [http://www.smh.com.au/nsw/barry-ofarrell-resigns-after-being-caught-out-over-bottle-of-wine-20140416-36qpg.html (''Sydney Morning Herald'')]

;Science and technology
*A [[Soyuz-U]] rocket carrying a new [[Egypt|Egyptian]] communication satellite, EgyptSat-2, was launched from the [[Baikonur Cosmodrome]] in [[Kazakhstan]]. [http://en.itar-tass.com/non-political/728290 (ITAR-TASS)]
*Scientists discover a new moon forming in the outer edge of [[Saturn]]'s [[Rings of Saturn#A_Ring|A ring]], unofficially called "Peggy". [https://web.archive.org/web/20140416210827/http://science.nasa.gov/science-news/science-at-nasa/2014/14apr_newmoon/ (NASA Science)]
*Scientists discover an [[egg cell|egg]] [[Integral membrane protein|membrane protein]], [[Juno (protein)|Juno]], that facilitates [[fertilisation]] in mammals. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/science/the-moment-of-conception-scientists-isolate-protein-that-governs-first-contact-between-egg-and-sperm-9265346.html (''The Independent'')]

;Sports
*In [[Association football|football]], [[Real Madrid C.F.]] defeats arch-rivals [[FC Barcelona]] 2-1 to secure its 19th [[Copa del Rey]] trophy. [https://www.theguardian.com/football/2014/apr/16/real-madrid-v-barcelona-copa-del-rey-final-live (''The Guardian'')]
